name: Joseph Cameron
bio:
With more than a decade of personal recovery and extensive experience in behavioral health business development, Joey has dedicated his career to expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based treatment for individuals and families affected by mental health and substance use disorders.
In 2020, Joey founded Quadrant Health Group with a vision of creating a boutique behavioral healthcare experience rooted in clinical excellence, compassion, and long-term recovery. What began with a single luxury treatment center in Laguna Beach has grown into a rapidly expanding, multi-state behavioral health organization serving communities across the country.
Under Joey's leadership, Quadrant Health Group has developed a network of inpatient, outpatient, and specialty behavioral health programs while remaining committed to raising the standard of care. His strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, and unwavering belief in recovery continue to guide the organization's growth and its mission of transforming lives through exceptional treatment and compassionate care.

name: Louis Iacona
bio:
Louis Iacona plays an integral role in driving the organization's growth, brand strategy, and community outreach initiatives. With more than a decade of personal recovery and extensive experience in marketing and business development, Louis combines professional expertise with a deeply personal commitment to helping individuals and families affected by substance use and mental health disorders.
As a certified interventionist, Louis has dedicated his career to connecting people with life-changing treatment and resources during some of the most difficult moments in their lives. His unique perspective, shaped by both lived experience and years of industry leadership, allows him to build meaningful relationships while advocating for accessible, high-quality behavioral healthcare.
Guided by a passion for service, Louis remains actively involved in supporting individuals and families seeking recovery. His leadership continues to help shape Quadrant Health Group's mission of delivering compassionate, evidence-based care while expanding access to treatment for communities across the country.

name: Nicholas Petrillo
bio:
Nicholas Petrillo serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Quadrant Health Group, where he is committed to expanding access to high-quality behavioral healthcare while fostering a culture centered on compassion, clinical excellence, and long-term recovery.
With extensive experience in behavioral healthcare operations, admissions, marketing, and organizational development, Nicholas has dedicated his career to helping treatment providers better serve individuals and families seeking care. His leadership has focused on building systems that make it easier for people to access treatment, receive personalized support, and continue their recovery journey with confidence.
Since co-founding Quadrant Health Group, Nicholas has led the organization's growth across multiple states while ensuring that quality of care remains at the center of every decision. He has helped develop an integrated network of behavioral health services that includes detoxification, residential treatment, outpatient care, and supportive recovery resources, allowing clients to receive seamless care throughout every stage of healing.
Nicholas believes that lasting recovery begins with treating every individual with dignity, respect, and compassion. He is passionate about creating environments where clients feel safe, supported, and empowered to achieve meaningful, lasting change. Under his leadership, Quadrant Health Group continues to invest in experienced clinicians, innovative treatment programs, and a patient-first approach that prioritizes individualized care.
As CEO, Nicholas remains focused on expanding access to evidence-based behavioral healthcare, strengthening clinical programs, and ensuring that every person who walks through Quadrant Health Group's doors receives the support they need to build a healthier future.

name: Michael Zornberg
bio:
Michael Zornberg serves as Chief Operating Officer of Quadrant Health Group, bringing extensive expertise in behavioral healthcare operations, regulatory compliance, and multi-state facility development. Since entering the behavioral health industry in 2018, Michael has played a pivotal role in the successful development, licensing, and operational oversight of more than 100 treatment facilities across the United States. His expertise includes state and federal regulatory compliance, Joint Commission accreditation, payer requirements, and complex healthcare transactions, helping organizations achieve operational excellence while maintaining the highest standards of patient care and safety.
Before transitioning into behavioral healthcare, Michael worked in strategic partnerships with the National Football League, where he developed a strong foundation in business operations, organizational growth, and relationship management. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and Business Law and has earned recognition as a trusted expert in healthcare compliance, frequently serving as an expert witness in legal proceedings involving behavioral health regulations and operational standards.
As Chief Operating Officer, Michael oversees the operational strategy and performance of Quadrant Health Group's growing network of behavioral healthcare facilities. His leadership is centered on building scalable, compliant systems that support clinical excellence, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth. Guided by a commitment to accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement, he is dedicated to advancing the organization's mission of delivering exceptional behavioral healthcare to the communities it serves.

name: Sal Rabie
bio:
Sal Rabie serves as the Chief Financial Officer for Quadrant Health Group, bringing more than 15 years of accounting, financial management, and strategic leadership experience. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Long Island University, C.W. Post, and is a licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
Prior to joining Quadrant Health Group, Sal spent a decade with a boutique accounting firm on Long Island, where he specialized in small business taxation and financial consulting. He later founded, owned, and successfully operated his own accounting firm for five years, leading a team of accounting professionals while providing comprehensive financial services to businesses across a variety of industries.
Throughout his career, Sal has developed extensive expertise in financial reporting, bookkeeping, payroll, tax planning and preparation, internal controls, and regulatory compliance. His experience includes preparing GAAP-compliant financial statements, serving on audit teams for both for-profit and nonprofit organizations, acting as an internal audit resource for companies requiring reviewed or audited financial statements, and representing businesses and individuals during IRS, state tax department, and Department of Labor audits. He has also served as a fractional Chief Financial Officer for numerous organizations, helping guide financial strategy, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.
As Chief Financial Officer, Sal oversees Quadrant Health Group's financial operations, ensuring fiscal responsibility while supporting the organization's continued growth and commitment to delivering high-quality behavioral healthcare.

name: Colin McBride
bio:
As Vice President of Revenue & Billing, Colin McBride provides executive oversight and leadership to Quadrant Billing Solutions (QBS)—Quadrant Health Group’s in-house billing company. Colin led the development of QBS from the ground up, building it to meet the complex demands of behavioral health providers. Though QBS operates under the Quadrant Health Group umbrella, it functions independently with its own systems, leadership, and results-driven infrastructure. QBS remains Colin’s primary focus; however, he also plays a key strategic role across Quadrant Health Group, supporting revenue operations through clinical quality oversight, and admissions strategy across the organization’s growing network of facilities. With over a decade of experience in behavioral health, Colin’s background in direct care and facility leadership gives him a deep understanding of the challenges providers face—insights that now inform his leadership across Quadrant Health Group. Colin’s passion lies in developing innovative solutions that bridge clinical care with financial strategy, improving both patient
outcomes and organizational performance.

name: Dr. Pamela Tambini
bio:
Dr. Pamela Tambini is a board-certified physician in Internal Medicine and Addiction Medicine, entrepreneur, and healthcare executive dedicated to advancing evidence-based treatment for individuals with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders. She is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of The Sober Connection, a physician-led medical services organization that partners with behavioral healthcare facilities nationwide to provide comprehensive medical leadership, provider staffing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance solutions.
With extensive experience across the continuum of addiction treatment—including medical detoxification, residential treatment, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and outpatient care—Dr. Tambini has developed scalable clinical programs that improve patient outcomes while helping organizations maintain regulatory excellence and operational efficiency. Her expertise includes addiction medicine, psychopharmacology, withdrawal management, medical stabilization, utilization review, physician leadership, and multi-state healthcare operations.
Prior to founding The Sober Connection, Dr. Tambini served as a hospitalist within the Veterans Health Administration, where she managed medically complex patients and collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality inpatient care. Her clinical expertise, combined with her operational leadership, provides a unique perspective on integrating medical excellence with sustainable healthcare systems.
Under Dr. Tambini's leadership, The Sober Connection has grown into a multi-state organization supporting behavioral healthcare facilities through physician staffing, medical directorships, quality improvement initiatives, provider education, credentialing, policy development, and clinical oversight. She is recognized for building high-performing medical teams, implementing standardized clinical processes, and helping treatment centers navigate accreditation, licensing, and payer requirements.
Dr. Tambini is passionate about raising the standard of addiction medicine by combining compassionate patient care with innovative operational strategies. Her leadership philosophy emphasizes clinical integrity, accountability, and collaboration, with a focus on creating systems that support both providers and the patients they serve.
She remains actively involved in medical education, physician mentorship, and the ongoing advancement of best practices in behavioral healthcare while continuing to care for patients and advise organizations on clinical program development, healthcare operations, and quality improvement initiatives.

name: Catherine Alpaugh
bio:
Catherine joined the Quadrant Health Group’s team as Executive Vice President bringing over a decade of industry experience and a proven track record of leadership in multisite organizations. Throughout her career, she has held key roles including Director of Admissions, where she successfully oversaw placement operations across multiple locations and was instrumental in driving growth, operational efficiency and expanding market presence.
She holds a Bachelor's degree in Marketing and a Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, combining strategic business insights with deep knowledge of healthcare operations. Her leadership is defined by a commitment to excellence, data-driven decision-making, and building high-performing teams that deliver measurable results.

name: Jessica Dalton
bio:
serves as Executive Vice President of Operations for Quadrant Health Group, bringing extensive leadership experience in behavioral healthcare operations, compliance, and organizational development. Throughout her career, she has overseen operations across multiple behavioral health and substance use treatment facilities, leading initiatives that strengthen operational performance, enhance regulatory compliance, and improve the overall quality of patient care.
With a deep understanding of healthcare operations, Jessica has successfully implemented standardized policies, optimized organizational processes, and fostered collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to support sustainable growth and clinical excellence. Her strategic approach to leadership has helped organizations maintain high standards while creating efficient, patient-centered systems of care.
Jessica earned her bachelor's degree from Indiana University of Pennsylvania and is a National Certified Peer Recovery Support Specialist (NCPRSS). She is recognized for her collaborative leadership style, commitment to professional development, and passion for empowering teams to achieve operational excellence. As Executive Vice President of Operations, she is dedicated to advancing Quadrant Health Group's mission by building high-performing teams and ensuring exceptional care across the organization's growing network of behavioral health facilities.

name: Riley Monahan
bio: Riley Monahan joins Quadrant Health Group with over a decade of experience in behavioral health, spanning clinical practice and organizational leadership. Prior to Quadrant, Riley worked in clinical and administrative roles at a large, multi-location Arizona-based behavioral health agency while working in a private practice setting serving high performers and entrepreneurs. His clinical background includes trauma-focused therapy, EMDR, and specialized intensives, along with corporate retreat facilitation and executive mediation. We're excited to have him on the team.

name: Chelsea Stelmach
bio: Chelsea Stelmach is the Director of Marketing at Quadrant Health Group, where she leads the organization's branding, digital marketing, communications, and public relations initiatives. With more than a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare marketing, she is passionate about building trusted brands, sharing meaningful stories, and connecting individuals and families with quality mental health and addiction treatment resources. Chelsea combines creative strategy with a patient-first approach to ensure every communication reflects the compassion, integrity, and excellence that define Quadrant Health Group.

name: Stephanie Hakim
bio:
Stephanie Hakim serves as the Director of Compliance for Quadrant Health Group, where she leads the organization's compliance, regulatory, and quality assurance initiatives across its behavioral healthcare programs. She is committed to fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and operational excellence by ensuring compliance is seamlessly integrated into every aspect of the organization.
What distinguishes Stephanie's approach to compliance is her comprehensive understanding of treatment center operations. Throughout her career, she has held leadership roles in executive operations, admissions, information technology, medication management, and clinical services as a Certified Drug and Alcohol Counselor (CADCII). This diverse experience provides her with a unique perspective on how regulatory requirements impact every stage of the patient experience—from the first point of contact through discharge planning, quality improvement, and organizational performance.
Stephanie leads the development and implementation of compliance programs, regulatory initiatives, policy development, internal auditing, corrective action planning, and accreditation readiness. She works collaboratively with state regulatory agencies and The Joint Commission to ensure Quadrant Health Group consistently meets and exceeds regulatory standards while advancing quality improvement, mitigating organizational risk, and promoting the delivery of safe, ethical, and high-quality care.
Beyond regulatory oversight, Stephanie is passionate about building sustainable systems that empower organizations to thrive. She believes compliance is more than meeting standards—it is the foundation of exceptional patient care, operational excellence, and organizational integrity. By fostering collaboration across clinical, operational, medical, and executive teams, she helps translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, sustainable processes that strengthen both compliance and organizational performance.
Stephanie is recognized for her strategic leadership, collaborative approach, and ability to bridge the gap between regulations and day-to-day operations. Her commitment to excellence continues to support Quadrant Health Group's mission of delivering compassionate, high-quality behavioral healthcare while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and accountability.

name: Marc North
bio:
Marc North has spent more than a decade serving the recovery community, beginning his career as a Certified Peer Recovery Specialist (CPRS) in nonprofit organizations. His frontline experience supporting individuals with substance use disorders built a strong foundation in recovery, leadership, and patient-centered care.
Marc advanced into leadership roles at Wellness Recovery Center of New Jersey, serving first as Director of Operations and later as Executive Director, where he led multidisciplinary teams, oversaw daily operations, and drove strategic initiatives that strengthened both organizational performance and patient care.
Today, Marc serves as Procurement Manager for Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees strategic sourcing, vendor partnerships, and purchasing operations across a multi-state network of behavioral healthcare facilities. His unique blend of recovery, operational, and executive leadership experience enables him to build efficient systems that strengthen organizational performance while supporting exceptional patient care.

name: Danielle Gorman
bio:
Danielle Gorman is the Executive Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group. Danielle brings extensive leadership experience and a hands-on approach to every aspect of the organization. Her role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, providing support wherever it is needed to help teams operate efficiently and successfully.
Danielle is passionate about building strong teams, creating organized systems, and helping others succeed. She takes great pride in being part of a company dedicated to changing lives by guiding individuals on their journey to recovery.

name: Diana Guzman
bio:
Diana Guzman serves as Human Resources Manager at Quadrant Health Group, where she is dedicated to fostering a workplace culture built on trust, communication, and employee engagement. She believes that people are the heart of every organization and that meaningful relationships are the foundation of a strong and successful team.
Passionate about creating a positive employee experience, Diana views communication as one of the most important aspects of human resources—not only ensuring information is shared clearly, but also making certain employees feel heard, supported, and valued. She strives to recognize each individual's contributions, celebrate achievements, and maintain an approachable presence where team members feel comfortable seeking guidance and support.
Diana is committed to helping cultivate an environment where employees feel connected, appreciated, and empowered to thrive. She believes that when people feel recognized and supported, they are better equipped to grow professionally, collaborate effectively, and make a meaningful impact on the individuals and communities Quadrant Health Group serves.

name: Armanee Cross
bio:
Armanee Cross, MBA serves as an HR Assistant/Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group, where she is dedicated to creating a positive employee experience and supporting team members throughout every stage of their career journey. She works closely with leadership and employees across recruitment, onboarding, HR operations, and day-to-day employee support to help foster an engaging and collaborative workplace.
Armanee holds a Master of Business Administration with a concentration in Human Resources Management and is passionate about building strong relationships, improving processes, and helping employees feel valued and supported. She believes that great workplaces are built by investing in great people and is committed to contributing to a culture where individuals and teams can thrive.

name: Kevin Bocanegra
bio:
Kevin Bocanegra is a Human Resources/Payroll Specialist at Quadrant Health Group, where he is dedicated to ensuring employees receive accurate, timely payroll while providing dependable support across payroll and human resources functions. As a U.S. Marine Corps veteran, Kevin brings the values of integrity, accountability, and service to every aspect of his work.
Kevin believes payroll is about more than processing numbers—it is about supporting the people behind them. He takes pride in managing payroll operations, assisting with payroll tax compliance, and maintaining the accuracy and reliability that employees and leadership depend on. Through clear communication, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence, he strives to create a positive experience for every employee.
Known for his professionalism and dependable approach, Kevin is committed to solving challenges, building trust, and contributing to a workplace where employees feel respected, supported, and valued. His mission is to help ensure every team member has the confidence that their contributions are recognized through accurate and efficient payroll services.

name: Maria Gonzalez
bio:
Maria Gonzalez serves as the Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group, where she is passionate about connecting talented professionals with meaningful career opportunities while creating a positive and welcoming hiring experience from the very first conversation.
Working closely with hiring managers and candidates, Maria supports the full recruitment and onboarding process, helping attract exceptional talent and ensure new team members feel informed, supported, and prepared for success. She values building lasting relationships, fostering open communication, and matching individuals with opportunities where they can grow professionally while making a meaningful impact.
Maria is proud to support Quadrant Health Group's mission by helping recruit and retain compassionate, dedicated professionals who are committed to providing outstanding behavioral healthcare to the individuals and communities they serve.

name: Emmanuel Lacruz
bio:
Emmanuel Lacruz serves as an HR Talent Acquisition Recruiter, where he is passionate about connecting talented healthcare professionals with opportunities to grow, make a meaningful impact, and build rewarding careers. He works closely with candidates and hiring managers to create a seamless, transparent, and positive recruitment experience from the initial conversation through the onboarding process.
Emmanuel believes that every great organization is built on exceptional people. He is committed to identifying individuals who not only possess the skills and experience needed for success but also share a dedication to delivering compassionate, high-quality care. Known for his approachable nature and strong communication skills, he takes pride in building lasting relationships while helping candidates find positions where they can thrive professionally.
With experience recruiting nurses, therapists, behavioral health professionals, and administrative staff, Emmanuel is dedicated to supporting Quadrant Health Group's mission by attracting outstanding talent and fostering a workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

name: Ben Kolb
bio:
Ben Kolb has been in long-term recovery since August 2011\. His personal journey through addiction and into sobriety gives him a deep, authentic understanding of the challenges individuals and families face.
Since 2016, Ben has dedicated his career to the addiction treatment field, specializing in building strong strategic relationships with hospitals, interventionists, therapists, and community partners across the country. In 2022, he co-founded Dallas Detox Center, helping to create a compassionate, clinically driven detox and treatment program that puts clients’ long-term success first.
Today, Ben continues to lead community outreach and partnerships for the center, ensuring that those who need help can find a trusted, effective path to recovery.

name: Douglas Penny
role: VP of Business Development West Coast
bio:
With over 15 years of experience in the behavioral health care industry, Douglas Penny has built a career dedicated to expanding access to quality treatment and leading growth initiatives across the country. Based in Southern California, he has played a key role in developing and managing rehabilitation centers nationwide, combining strategic business development with a deep commitment to improving lives.
Douglas specializes in behavioral health program development, strategic partnerships, and team leadership, guiding organizations from concept to full-scale operations. With a proven ability to build strong referral networks and high-performing teams, he has helped treatment providers strengthen their impact and achieve sustainable growth.
Driven by a passion for behavioral health and a results-oriented approach, Douglas continues to champion innovation, collaboration, and excellence in every project he undertakes.

name: Mike Simmons
role: VP of Business Development East Coast
bio:
Mike Simmons serves as Vice President of Business Development for Quadrant Health Group, where he leads referral network expansion, admissions growth, and strategic partnerships.
Mike brings nearly a decade of experience in the behavioral health industry, with a strong track record in relationship-driven business development and patient acquisition. He began his career in alumni services, where he developed deep expertise in long-term engagement and referral pipeline development, which has translated into consistent admissions growth and strong industry relationships.
In his current role, Mike is responsible for expanding referral channels, strengthening provider relationships, and driving census growth across Quadrant’s East Coast locations. His ability to combine industry knowledge with a performance-driven approach to business development has been a key contributor to the platform’s growth and market positioning.
Mike plays a critical role in maintaining a sustainable and diversified admissions pipeline, supporting continued expansion and long-term value creation.

name: Richard Bradshaw
bio:
Richard Bradshaw is a seasoned professional in behavioral health and addiction treatment with over 15 years of experience in addiction and recovery, currently serving as Business Development Representative for Quadrant Health Group, a nationwide network of luxury addiction treatment centers focused on personalized, evidence-based care.
With extensive experience as Director of Admissions, Business Development, and over the last decade, he drives growth through strategic outreach, admissions processes, and operational excellence in the substance use disorder field.

name: Maggie Galleymore
bio:
Maggie Galleymore brings over a decade of experience in the substance use and mental health treatment field, with a strong passion for helping individuals and families navigate the path to healing. Her commitment to this work is deeply rooted in both professional expertise and personal understanding, allowing her to connect with clients and partners in a meaningful and compassionate way.
As a Business Development Representative for Quadrant Health Group, supporting both Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness, Maggie is dedicated to building authentic relationships and helping individuals find the level of care that best supports their needs. She believes in meeting people where they are, advocating fiercely for those in need, and working collaboratively with trusted partners who share the same mission of recovery and healing.
Maggie is committed to ongoing growth in the behavioral health space and stays informed on evolving treatment approaches and recovery pathways to better serve the individuals and communities she works with.

name: EJ Larson
bio:
Elijah (EJ) serves as a Business Development Representative at Quadrant Health Group, bringing nearly a decade of experience in the substance abuse and mental health treatment field. His well-rounded background across multiple roles, including Behavioral Health Technician, Alumni Coordinator, and Outreach leadership, has given him a comprehensive understanding of the recovery journey and the importance of connecting individuals to the right level of care.
Elijah is deeply committed to building meaningful relationships within the community and expanding access to quality treatment. His approach is rooted in authenticity, compassion, and a strong belief that everyone deserves the opportunity to heal.
Originally from Las Vegas, Elijah studied at Mira Costa College and continues to grow professionally through hands-on experience and service. In his role at Quadrant Health Group, he is focused on fostering partnerships, supporting referral networks, and helping individuals and families take the first step toward lasting recovery.

name: Sage Steinberg
bio:
Sage's personal recovery journey ignited a passion for serving others and led her to a career in behavioral health. Over the past four years, she has focused on building strong relationships throughout the community while advocating for education, prevention, and treatment for substance use and mental health disorders.
As a Business Development Representative serving the east coast area, Sage is driven by the belief that meaningful collaboration creates better outcomes. She is dedicated to connecting providers, resources, and individuals in ways that make recovery more accessible, while fostering lasting partnerships that strengthen the continuum of care.

name: Nick Gore
bio: Nick Gore is a business development leader with nearly a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare. In long-term recovery since 2016, he is passionate about connecting individuals, families, employers, and healthcare partners with quality treatment resources. Throughout his career, Nick has built strong partnerships across healthcare systems, businesses, and communities, while advocating for improved access to mental health and substance use disorder treatment. His personal journey and professional experience drive his commitment to helping others find hope and recovery.

name: Lexie Zeller
bio: Lexie Zeller is a dedicated alumni relations professional with experience developing and growing alumni engagement programs that foster lifelong connections and meaningful involvement. With a strong background in relationship management, program development, and strategic planning, Lexie is passionate about creating alumni experiences that inspire connection, mentorship, and continued support. As National Alumni Director, she is leading the development of a nationwide alumni program focused on building an engaged network that empowers alumni to stay connected, give back, and make a lasting impact in their own recovery communities.

name: Robert Spady
bio:
As the Admissions Director at Quadrant Health Group, (change title) I understand that seeking help for addiction is a profoundly courageous act, often made during one of life's most challenging periods. With 10 years of dedicated professional experience in the field, my primary focus is to provide a clear, compassionate, and supportive pathway for individuals and families seeking treatment. I'm committed to guiding you through every step of the admissions process with empathy and expertise, ensuring you feel understood and confident in the care options available.
What truly drives my approach is a deep, personal understanding of the recovery journey. Having navigated my own battle with addiction for over a decade, and celebrating 12 years of sobriety through the principles of the 12 Steps AA program, I know firsthand the challenges and triumphs involved. This lived experience allows me to connect with clients and their loved ones on a uniquely empathetic level, offering not just guidance but also genuine hope for a new beginning.
Originally from Trenton, NJ, I am passionate about connecting people with the vital support they need to transform their lives. My goal is to alleviate the stress often associated with beginning treatment, providing comprehensive information and a steady hand as you take this crucial step towards healing and lasting recovery. I am here to help you or your loved one embark on a path to a healthier, more fulfilling future.

name: John Jurman
bio:
John Jurman is the Admissions Manager at Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees the admissions team and helps ensure a smooth, supportive process for individuals entering the company's care facilities. With over eight years of experience in healthcare admissions, John brings a strong commitment to organization, communication, and compassionate service, playing a key role in helping families navigate an often-stressful time with clarity and care.
Outside of work, John enjoys spending quality time with his family and cheering on Philadelphia's sports teams. Whether it's watching the Eagles on a Sunday or catching a Phillies game, he brings the same passion and dedication to his personal life that he brings to his role at Quadrant Health Group.

name: Alanna McMurtrey
bio:
Alanna McMurtrey serves as the Lead Case Manager for the Southern California facilities of Quadrant Health Group, where she oversees case management services and supports clients through detox and residential levels of care. In her role, she coordinates client care, provides leadership and clinical support to case management staff, and helps ensure that each individual receives consistent, structured, and personalized support throughout their treatment journey.
With several years of experience in behavioral health and addiction treatment, Alanna has developed a strong passion for helping individuals overcome substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health challenges. She is dedicated to fostering engagement in treatment, promoting personal growth, and supporting clients as they work toward sustainable, long-term recovery.
Alanna takes a client-centered, strengths-based approach to care, meeting individuals where they are and helping them build upon their unique strengths. She is committed to creating a safe, respectful, and supportive environment where clients feel heard, valued, and empowered to make meaningful changes in their lives. Through collaboration, compassion, and clinical consistency, she strives to help clients develop the skills, confidence, and stability needed to achieve lasting recovery and improved well-being.

name: Alicia Joslin
bio:
With a deep passion for recovery and mental health care, Alicia Joslin brings empathy, leadership, and dedication to her role as Program Director at Marina Harbor Detox. She works closely with both clients and staff to foster an environment centered on accountability, compassion, and personal growth.
Alicia understands that recovery is not one-size-fits-all and believes every client deserves individualized support and encouragement throughout their treatment journey. Her goal is to help clients feel supported during some of the most difficult moments of their lives while empowering them to move toward lasting recovery and stability.

name: Angela Taylor
role: Case Manager at Hillside Mission Recovery
bio:
Angela Taylor, serves as a Case Manager dedicated to supporting individuals throughout their recovery journey. With experience in the substance use treatment field, Angela is passionate about helping clients navigate the treatment process with greater confidence, comfort, and purpose while fostering personal growth and long-term success.
Known for her compassionate and supportive approach, Angela strives to make the recovery experience as meaningful and stress-free as possible. She is committed to helping clients access the resources, guidance, and encouragement they need to build a strong foundation for lasting change.
Angela is currently pursuing a degree in Human Services and plans to continue advancing her education to further enhance her ability to serve individuals, families, and communities impacted by substance use and behavioral health challenges.

name: Anom Grant
bio:
As an IT Director with over a decade of experience, I bring a distinctive approach to technology leadership. My background in Psychology isn't just a detail; it's the very foundation of my career transition into IT. I firmly believe that technology should empower, not complicate, the human experience at work. This unique perspective drives me to transform tech landscapes, focusing on efficiency and innovation by ensuring IT initiatives truly align with business goals and build robust, scalable systems that enhance both organizational growth and overall user well-being.
My core strengths lie in dynamic team leadership, strategic project management, and comprehensive system optimizations. I consistently apply these skills to refine our technological infrastructure and streamline workflows. This ensures our IT operations are not only resilient and reliable but also directly contribute to achieving the organization's strategic objectives, making technology a true enabler. Moving forward, I'm passionate about leveraging my expertise to deepen organizational efficiency in ways that genuinely uplift both our internal teams and our valued clients. My aim is to implement tech solutions that optimize performance while simultaneously fostering a seamless, intuitive, and highly productive experience for everyone. I'm always eager to connect with fellow leaders to explore how thoughtful IT strategy can spark innovation and significantly boost user satisfaction.

name: Antoine Gross Sr.
role: Director of Clinical Services - Dallas Detox Center
bio:
Antoine is an independently licensed counselor with nearly a decade of experience in the mental health field. Over the past three years, he has provided independent counseling services, supporting individuals who are committed to creating meaningful and lasting change in their lives.
Antoine is deeply passionate about walking alongside individuals during some of their most challenging and transformative seasons. He believes therapy should be a safe, welcoming space where clients can openly explore their identity, experiences, and struggles without judgment—while also being thoughtfully challenged to grow.
His clinical approach is collaborative and practical, focusing on identifying patterns, building effective coping strategies, and developing the skills necessary for long-term success. Antoine's goal is for each client to leave treatment feeling empowered, balanced, and equipped to maintain continued growth well beyond their time in therapy.
He firmly believes in the principle: 'You can be great by chance, or you can be great by choice,' and is dedicated to helping individuals intentionally choose a path toward growth, healing, and fulfillment.

name: Ashley Hurtado
bio:
Ashley Hurtado, is an Associate Marriage and Family Therapist dedicated to helping individuals navigate the early stages of recovery with compassion, understanding, and clinical excellence. As a therapist at Marina Harbor Detox, Ashley works closely with clients as they begin their healing journey, providing trauma-informed care and individualized support during one of the most transformative periods of treatment.
Ashley earned her Master of Arts in Clinical Psychology from Pepperdine University and her Bachelor of Arts in Psychology from San Francisco State University. Her educational background, combined with her commitment to client-centered care, allows her to help individuals address the emotional, psychological, and behavioral challenges that often accompany substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health concerns.
In her role, Ashley facilitates individual and group therapy sessions, helping clients develop insight into the underlying factors contributing to their struggles while building healthier coping skills and emotional resilience. She is passionate about creating a safe, supportive therapeutic environment where clients feel heard, respected, and empowered to make meaningful changes in their lives.
Ashley's clinical approach is collaborative, strengths-based, and rooted in meeting each person where they are. She believes that lasting recovery begins with genuine connection and that every individual has the capacity for growth, healing, and transformation. Through empathy, encouragement, and evidence-based therapeutic practices, she helps clients build a strong foundation for sustained recovery and long-term well-being.
Ashley is committed to supporting clients through every stage of the recovery process, helping them cultivate hope, confidence, and the tools needed to create healthier, more fulfilling lives.

name: Christi Llamas
bio:
Christi Llamas is a dedicated Case Manager whose passion for helping others is rooted in both personal and professional experience. Having grown up in a family impacted by mental health and substance use challenges, and later navigating her own recovery journey, Christi brings a unique level of empathy, understanding, and authenticity to her work.
Her lived experience has given her firsthand insight into the complexities of addiction, recovery, and the barriers many individuals face when seeking support. Through overcoming challenges associated with substance use and involvement with the criminal justice system, Christi developed a deep commitment to helping others find hope, stability, and a path forward.
As a Case Manager, Christi is dedicated to building meaningful connections with clients, advocating for their needs, and helping them access the resources and support necessary for lasting recovery. She is passionate about empowering individuals to recognize their strengths and create positive change in their lives.
Christi is currently pursuing her education with the long-term goal of becoming a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), allowing her to further expand her knowledge and ability to support individuals and families affected by substance use and mental health disorders.

name: Christina Lilly
bio:
Christina Lilly serves as the Office Manager at Wellness Recovery Center, where she plays a vital role in ensuring the day-to-day operations of the facility run smoothly and efficiently. Since joining the team in 2024, Christina has become a central point of support for all departments, helping to maintain organization, communication, and overall workflow across the organization.
In her role, Christina oversees administrative operations, coordinates office procedures, and provides ongoing support to clinical, case management, and leadership teams. She is known for her strong ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and respond quickly to the evolving needs of both staff and clients.
A natural people-person, Christina brings empathy and approachability into every interaction. She takes pride in being accessible and responsive, fostering a supportive and collaborative environment throughout the workplace. Her problem-solving skills allow her to effectively address challenges as they arise, ensuring minimal disruption to daily operations.
Christina is deeply committed to helping Wellness Recovery Center function at its highest level, consistently going above and beyond to support staff, enhance efficiency, and contribute to a positive, client-centered atmosphere.
group: New Jersey Facilities — Wellness Recovery NJ

name: Cristina Turiello
bio:
Cristina Turiello is a kind, compassionate, and highly skilled behavioral health professional with over five years of experience at Quadrant Health Group. As the Director of Client Care, she leads a team dedicated to supporting individuals facing substance use and mental health challenges, ensuring they receive personalized, respectful, and effective care.
Cristina's journey in healthcare began as a patient advocate, where she championed the rights and well-being of individuals navigating complex systems. Her deep-rooted passion for helping others in all aspects of life continues to drive her work and leadership style today.
With a strong foundation in organization, attention to detail, and team leadership, Cristina brings structure and clarity to challenging environments while maintaining a warm, client-centered approach. She is known not only for her operational expertise but for her unwavering kindness, empathy, and ability to connect meaningfully with both clients and colleagues.
Cristina remains committed to making a difference—one compassionate interaction at a time.

name: Deborah Wade
bio: Deborah has been a dedicated member of the Dallas Detox Center team for the past three years. With a strong passion for client care and recovery, Deborah plays a vital role in medically supporting clients through the detoxification process. She also manages client care at the Residential Treatment Center (RTC) level of care and provides leadership and oversight to the nursing staff. Her compassionate approach and clinical expertise help ensure a safe, supportive environment for clients at every stage of their recovery journey.

name: Dr. Olivia M. Gibson-Delaney, M.D.
bio: Dr. Olivia Gibson-Delaney earned her medical degree from Rutgers New Jersey Medical School in Newark, NJ. She completed her Psychiatry residency at Mount Sinai Morningside and Mount Sinai West in New York, NY, where she developed expertise in diagnosing and treating a wide range of mental health conditions. Dr. Gibson-Delaney is dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based care to her patients and is committed to advancing mental health awareness and treatment in her community.
group: New Jersey Facilities — Wellness Recovery NJ

name: Elizabeth Wald
role: Program Director - Ocean Coast Recovery Center
bio:
Elizabeth Wald serves as Program Director for Quadrant Health Group's Southern California facilities, where she oversees program operations, clinical coordination, and day-to-day management across the organization's behavioral health treatment centers. She works closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure each program delivers exceptional, individualized care while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
Since entering the behavioral health field in 2021, Elizabeth has been an integral part of Quadrant Health Group's growth, beginning with the opening of one of its Northern California facilities. Her leadership has been instrumental in fostering compassionate, client-centered treatment environments where individuals receive personalized support throughout every stage of their recovery journey.
Elizabeth's passion for behavioral healthcare is deeply rooted in her own lived experience in recovery. She believes that meaningful healing begins by meeting individuals where they are, building genuine connections, and empowering them with the tools, education, and support needed to achieve lasting recovery. Her leadership is driven by empathy, authenticity, and an unwavering commitment to helping others reclaim their lives while supporting her teams in delivering the highest level of care.

name: Emma Fyffe
bio: Emma is a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) and a compassionate, client-centered mental health professional. She serves as the primary therapist at Greater Texas Behavioral Clinic, an intensive outpatient program providing care for individuals experiencing mental health and substance use challenges. In her role, Emma facilitates both individual and group therapy, supporting clients as they build insight, develop healthier coping skills, and work toward sustainable recovery. She values creating a safe, nonjudgmental environment where clients feel heard, supported, and empowered. Her approach emphasizes emotional awareness, accountability, and practical tools to promote long-term growth and stability.

name: Erika "Riky" Hanaumi
credentials: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW); Master of Social Work (MSW), California State University, Fullerton (2013); trained in evidence-based modalities including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
bio:
Erika “Riky” Hanaumi is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with more than 20 years of experience in behavioral health and addiction treatment. She currently serves as Clinical Director for Quadrant Health Group’s California facilities, where she oversees clinical programming, mentors and supports therapists in developing effective treatment strategies, and ensures the delivery of compassionate, individualized, and clinically sound care. Her leadership focuses on promoting evidence-based practices, clinical excellence, and positive treatment outcomes for individuals with co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders.
Riky began her career working with individuals experiencing homelessness, providing intensive support, advocacy, and resource coordination to help clients overcome barriers and access essential services. This experience fueled her passion for serving vulnerable populations and inspired her to pursue a Master of Social Work degree from California State University, Fullerton, which she earned in 2013.
Throughout her career, Riky has worked in both inpatient and outpatient settings, providing therapy, crisis intervention, case management, and recovery-oriented services. She has extensive experience supporting adults with complex behavioral health needs, including co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders, while helping individuals navigate the challenges of recovery and major life transitions.
Riky is trained in evidence-based treatment modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). She is passionate about helping clients build resilience, strengthen coping skills, improve interpersonal relationships, and achieve lasting recovery.

name: Erika Sirianos
bio:
With over 20 years of progressive leadership experience, Erika Sirianos is a seasoned Human Resources and Payroll Director with a dynamic background spanning both the nonprofit and corporate sectors. Her expertise lies in aligning people strategies with organizational goals, ensuring compliance, and fostering inclusive workplace cultures that drive performance and engagement.
Throughout her career, Erika has led HR and payroll operations in diverse environments, including behavioral health and substance abuse treatment organizations as well as educational institutions. Her hands-on experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, managing multi-state payroll systems, and implementing HR best practices uniquely positions her to support mission-driven and growth-oriented organizations alike.
Known for her collaborative approach and strong ethical compass, Erika has a proven track record in talent management, benefits administration, policy development, and organizational change. She is especially passionate about shaping people and culture strategies that cultivate belonging, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Erika holds a deep commitment to employee well-being and organizational integrity, making her a trusted advisor to leadership teams and a valued partner to staff at all levels.

name: Erin Crawford
credentials: Registered Nurse (RN); Bachelor of Science in Nursing (Chamberlain University); currently pursuing Master of Science in Nursing with a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) concentration
bio:
Born in Okinawa, Japan and raised in South Florida, Erin Crawford is a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse with a strong commitment to serving individuals affected by substance abuse, mental health challenges, and health disparities within our communities. She is a proud mother of two and finds balance between her professional and personal life. When she's not cheering her children on at the soccer pitch, Erin enjoys relaxing at the beach with her beloved dog.
Erin graduated with President's Distinguished Honors from Chamberlain University, earning her Bachelor of Science in Nursing. She is currently pursuing her Master of Science in Nursing with a concentration as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), continuing her mission to broaden her impact in patient care and advocacy.
With a deep-rooted passion for helping others, Erin focuses her nursing career on empowering individuals facing addiction and mental health challenges. She is a fierce advocate for equitable care and works to uplift those experiencing social, economic, and healthcare disparities. Erin brings empathy, strength, and dedication to every role she takes on—driven by a desire to be a source of support and hope for those most in need.
group: Florida Facilities — Seaside Wellness of Palm Beach

name: Gus Saadeh
bio:
As the Director of Operations at Marina Harbor Detox, Gus Saadeh manages and oversees the day-to-day operations with a strong focus on facilities maintenance, Health & Safety compliance, and staff coordination. Working closely with the Program Director, Gus ensures staff are trained effectively and that services are delivered with professionalism, compassion, and alignment with industry best practices.
Gus's path into this field is deeply personal—being in recovery himself provides a unique understanding of the challenges clients face in early sobriety. This lived experience drives his commitment to creating an environment that is safe, respectful, and grounded in genuine hope. Every operational decision Gus makes is guided by a client-centered mindset, knowing firsthand how critical stability and empathy are during the early stages of recovery.
Before stepping into this role, Gus worked as a licensed realtor in San Francisco. That experience taught him how to connect with people from all walks of life, build trust quickly, and communicate with empathy—skills that now serve him well in supporting clients, families, and staff in a treatment setting. He has also worked closely with aging individuals and their families on issues of trust, long-term planning, and transitions of care, bringing sensitivity and structure to complex and emotional situations.
Gus's areas of expertise include recovery-based operational leadership, staff and facilities management, and maintaining Health & Safety compliance. He is also skilled in providing empathetic support to clients and their families and has a strong background in transitional planning for aging adults and their loved ones. These combined strengths allow him to bring a balanced approach of structure, compassion, and practical guidance to every aspect of his role.

name: Haley Wadlington
bio:
Haley Wadlington serves as the Director of Client Care, where she is dedicated to ensuring that each client receives compassionate, individualized, and consistent support throughout their treatment experience. In her role, Haley helps oversee client care coordination, discharge planning, family communication, and ongoing support services to help clients feel seen, heard, and guided during a vulnerable time in their lives.
Haley is passionate about creating a client-centered environment built on dignity, accountability, and meaningful connection. She works closely with clients, families, and the clinical team to help identify needs, reduce barriers, and support a smooth transition into the next appropriate level of care. Her approach emphasizes advocacy, clear communication, and practical support, ensuring that clients are not only cared for during treatment but also prepared for continued success after discharge.
With a strong commitment to ethical care and trauma-informed support, Haley strives to make every client interaction purposeful, respectful, and rooted in hope. Her goal is to help clients and their loved ones feel supported, informed, and empowered as they move forward in their recovery journey.

name: Halie Nall
role: Case Manager at Ocean Coast Recovery Center
bio:
Halie Nall is a dedicated Case Manager who is passionate about supporting individuals throughout their recovery journey and helping them access the resources, tools, and support needed to build healthy, fulfilling lives. Her commitment to this work is shaped by both professional experience and personal lived experience with addiction and mental health challenges, as well as witnessing the impact of substance use within her own family.
These experiences have provided Halie with a deep sense of empathy, understanding, and compassion for those facing similar struggles. She believes that recovery is possible for everyone and is committed to meeting clients where they are, offering encouragement, advocacy, and support every step of the way.
Known for her compassionate approach and genuine connection with clients, Halie strives to create a safe and supportive environment where individuals feel heard, valued, and empowered as they work toward lasting recovery and personal growth.

name: Ila Holgerson
bio:
Ila serves as the Director of Clinical Operations at Wellness Recovery Center, where she has been a dedicated member of the team since 2023\. Originally from Gilbert, Arizona, she brings a compassionate, client-centered approach to leadership, with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality, individualized care that supports lasting recovery.
As Director of Clinical Operations, Ila oversees the day-to-day clinical operations of the facility, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure seamless coordination of care, regulatory compliance, and exceptional client outcomes. Drawing on her background in case management, she is passionate about removing barriers to recovery and developing systems that allow both clients and staff to thrive. Known for her strong leadership, collaborative mindset, and problem-solving abilities, Ila is dedicated to fostering a supportive environment where every client feels heard, valued, and empowered throughout their treatment journey.
group: New Jersey Facilities — Wellness Recovery NJ

name: Jaclyn Paradise
bio:
Jaclyn Paradise is a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) and Certified Trauma Professional who works with adults navigating trauma, anxiety, life transitions, and recovery. She earned her master's degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling from Rider University and has extensive experience in both private practice and intensive outpatient settings, supporting individuals with co-occurring mental health and substance use challenges.
Jaclyn's approach is holistic and trauma-informed, integrating parts work, mindfulness, and body-based practices to help clients reconnect with themselves and feel safe in their own bodies. She is especially passionate about inner child healing, self-empowerment, and guiding clients through meaningful life changes.
Drawing from both clinical training and personal insight, Jaclyn creates a grounded, supportive space where clients can explore, grow, and develop a deeper understanding of who they are.
group: New Jersey Facilities — Wellness Recovery NJ

name: Jacob Cameron
credentials: Registered Substance Use Disorder Counselor (SUDCC I)
bio:
Jacob Cameron serves as the Client Care Director at Quadrant Health Group and is a Registered Substance Use Disorder Counselor (SUDCC I). Passionate about helping individuals navigate the recovery process, Jacob is dedicated to creating a treatment experience that is both meaningful and engaging. He believes that lasting recovery is built through genuine connection, compassionate support, and an environment where clients feel valued every step of the way.
In his role, Jacob works to ensure that each client receives personalized care and experiences a sense of belonging throughout their treatment journey. His goal is to help individuals not only achieve recovery but also discover that life in recovery can be fulfilling, rewarding, and enjoyable. Through his commitment to client-centered care, Jacob strives to make a lasting positive impact on the lives of those he serves.

name: Jada Spencer
bio:
Jada brings over five years of experience in mental and behavioral health, driven by a genuine passion for supporting individuals through life's most challenging seasons. She is committed to building meaningful, authentic connections so clients feel safe, supported, and comfortable being open throughout their treatment journey. As a Case Manager, Jada helps clients navigate everyday stressors while identifying practical next steps toward stability and long-term growth.
Wellness plays a central role in her approach. Through her own grounding routines, including Pilates, Jada has developed a deep appreciation for the connection between physical and emotional regulation. She encourages clients to explore movement, structure, and self-care practices that promote balance and reduce stress. Her goal is for every individual she works with to leave treatment feeling more stable, confident, and prepared for the road ahead.

name: Jeremiah Ross
bio:
Jeremiah Ross, is a dedicated healthcare professional with more than 10 years of patient care experience and a strong background in substance use disorder treatment, client care coordination, and clinical team leadership. As the Nursing Supervisor, Jeremiah plays an integral role in supporting both clients and staff, helping oversee day-to-day clinical operations, medication-assisted treatment (MAT) protocols, documentation compliance, staff development, and multidisciplinary collaboration to ensure the highest standards of care.
Passionate about helping individuals navigate the recovery process, Jeremiah is committed to creating a safe, supportive, and structured treatment environment where clients can build stability, develop healthy coping skills, and work toward lasting recovery. His leadership style emphasizes compassion, accountability, and teamwork, helping foster positive outcomes for both clients and clinical staff.

name: Joshua Leder
bio:
Joshua Leder serves as Director of Operations for the Texas facilities under Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees daily operations and supports the continued growth and development of the organization's behavioral health programs across the state.
Originally born in Colorado and raised primarily in Texas, Joshua brings both personal passion and professional dedication to his role. As a proud father of two children, he values family, purpose, and creating a positive impact in the lives of others.
Joshua is deeply committed to helping individuals build healthier, more fulfilling lives while encouraging hope, healing, and personal growth. Guided by compassion, understanding, and faith, he strives to support others in recognizing that lasting change and recovery are possible. Drawing from his own experiences and journey, Joshua is passionate about inspiring those around him through strength, empathy, and service to others.

name: Justin White
bio:
Justin White serves as Program Director for Quadrant Health Group's Southern California facilities, providing operational leadership and program oversight across the organization's behavioral health treatment centers. In this role, he works closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure each facility delivers high-quality, individualized care while maintaining excellence in clinical programming, regulatory compliance, and day-to-day operations.
A Registered Addiction Counselor, Justin brings extensive experience in both detoxification and residential treatment settings. His leadership is rooted in the belief that recovery is never one-size-fits-all, and he is committed to fostering treatment environments where every client feels respected, supported, and empowered throughout their healing journey.
Known for his compassionate and collaborative leadership style, Justin is passionate about developing strong teams and creating programs that promote lasting recovery. He believes meaningful change begins with genuine human connection and is dedicated to helping both clients and staff reach their fullest potential. Through his leadership, he continues to advance Quadrant Health Group's mission of providing exceptional, evidence-based behavioral healthcare across Southern California.

name: Lamont Damon, AMFT
bio:
Lamont Damon is an Associate Marriage and Family Therapist dedicated to helping individuals navigate substance use recovery and behavioral health challenges with compassion, understanding, and evidence-based care. With experience working in detoxification and residential treatment settings, Lamont facilitates process groups, mindfulness groups, and trauma-informed therapeutic interventions designed to support healing and personal growth.
His clinical approach is rooted in creating a safe, supportive environment where clients can openly explore their emotions, strengthen recovery skills, develop healthy coping strategies, and build greater self-awareness. Drawing from person-centered, cognitive behavioral, mindfulness-based, and trauma-informed modalities, Lamont tailors his work to meet each individual's unique needs and goals.
Passionate about empowering individuals on their recovery journey, Lamont strives to help clients build resilience, foster meaningful change, and establish a strong foundation for long-term wellness and sustained recovery.

name: Michael McArthur
bio:
I am the Director of Nursing for California facilities, overseeing all medical staff and client care operations. My journey into nursing was inspired by a personal desire to provide hope and compassion during life's most challenging moments. Watching nurses care for my family during a difficult time, I realized how powerful a little hope and dedicated care can be. This inspired me to pursue a career in nursing, knowing I could make a difference when people need it most.
I love working in addiction recovery because it allows me to witness clients grow and thrive within our walls. Our staff's client-focused approach creates a positive, motivating environment that makes coming to work truly rewarding.
Outside of my professional life, I am a proud father of four wonderful kids. They are my greatest inspiration—teaching me patience, resilience, and the importance of hope every day. My personal recovery journey has also strengthened my understanding of overcoming adversity, and it fuels my dedication to helping others find their path to healing.
I work in this industry because I believe that substance use disorder and behavioral health are underserved populations that deserve attention, compassion, and support. I am excited to be on the front lines helping to reduce stigma and provide clients with genuine opportunities for recovery.
Personally, I am passionate about my family, continuous improvement in patient care through scientific and technological advances, and my love for the Los Angeles Lakers. My goal is to make a meaningful difference, one life at a time, with hope, compassion, and unwavering dedication.

name: Michael Meagher
credentials: MSW, LCSW, CAP; Master of Social Work from Samford University; Licensed Clinical Social Worker and Certified Addiction Professional in the state of Florida; EMDR trained
bio:
Michael Meagher, MSW, LCSW, CAP, is the Clinical Director with more than 13 years of experience in the behavioral health and substance use treatment field. He holds a Master of Social Work from Samford University and is both a Licensed Clinical Social Worker and Certified Addiction Professional in the state of Florida. Michael is also EMDR trained and specializes in co-occurring disorders, trauma-informed care, and addiction treatment.
Throughout his career, Michael has worked across multiple levels of care, beginning in recovery support services before advancing into counseling, operations, and executive clinical leadership. As Clinical Director, he oversees clinical programming, staff supervision, regulatory compliance, utilization review, and multidisciplinary treatment coordination. He is passionate about creating individualized, evidence-based treatment experiences that support long-term recovery and meaningful personal growth. 'This is not just my profession, it's my passion.'
group: Florida Facilities — Seaside Wellness of Palm Beach

name: Michelle Szwed
credentials: LPC, LCADC, ACS, BCC, NCC, CCTP, BA
bio:
Michelle Szwed is a Licensed Professional Counselor and Licensed Clinical Alcohol and Drug Counselor with experience treating co-occurring disorders, addiction, trauma, and substance use. She has worked across private practice, partial hospitalization, and intensive outpatient settings, where she has developed a strong clinical foundation through hands-on experience, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, and a commitment to ongoing professional growth.
Michelle is known for her empathetic and grounded approach, creating a therapeutic environment where clients feel supported, understood, and empowered. Her clinical strengths include active listening, thoughtful communication, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to foster meaningful engagement in both individual and group settings. She is especially skilled at leading interactive psychoeducational and process groups while maintaining an authentic, down-to-earth presence.
In her work, Michelle draws from a range of evidence-based modalities, including DBT, Motivational Interviewing, Internal Family Systems, EMDR, Cognitive Processing Therapy, relapse prevention, and expressive arts therapies. She is trained in both EMDR and Brainspotting and specializes in supporting individuals navigating trauma, borderline personality disorder, and substance use challenges.
In addition to her counseling credentials, Michelle is a board-certified life coach (BCC), nationally certified counselor (NCC), certified clinical trauma professional (CCTP), and certified behavior assistant (BA), reflecting her dedication to providing comprehensive, compassionate care.
group: New Jersey Facilities — Wellness Recovery NJ

name: Monica Olivares
credentials: CADII (Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor II / CADC II)
bio:
Monica Olivares serves as the Clinical Supervisor for Quadrant Health Group’s California facilities, bringing over 11 years of experience in the behavioral health field and a deeply personal passion for recovery and healing. Throughout her career, Monica has worked across nearly every level of care — including Detox, Residential, IOP, PHP, and Outpatient programs — while holding a wide range of roles from Behavioral Health Technician and Case Manager to Program Manager and Program Director.
Monica holds a CADC II certification and has extensive experience supporting individuals struggling with substance use disorders, co-occurring mental health conditions, and eating disorders. Her leadership style is rooted in compassion, authenticity, accountability, and connection, helping create treatment environments where clients feel genuinely supported, understood, and empowered throughout their recovery journey.
In addition to her professional experience, Monica brings 13 years of personal recovery experience to the work she does each day. Her lived experience allows her to connect with clients on a deeper level while helping foster hope, trust, and meaningful change. She believes recovery should be individualized, engaging, and centered around human connection, emphasizing that healing can happen while still embracing joy, humor, and community.
Known for her energy, heart, and dedication, Monica is passionate about helping both clients and staff grow while cultivating strong, supportive treatment teams across the California programs. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family, being outdoors, attending music festivals, exploring escape rooms, traveling, and creating memorable life experiences.

name: Nicholas Incognito Jr.
bio: Nicholas Incognito Jr. is a seasoned professional with over a decade of experience in the behavioral healthcare sector, currently serving as the Director of QA at Quadrant Health Group, Inc. In this role, he is at the forefront of providing a compassionate and streamlined entry point for individuals seeking treatment for substance abuse and mental health. His leadership philosophy centers on a blend of strategic oversight and hands-on guidance, ensuring that every client's journey begins with professionalism and empathy. Throughout his career, Nicholas has developed a strong reputation for optimizing operational efficiency and enhancing client outcomes. He has a proven track record of significantly improving conversion rates and client engagement, which has been instrumental in the growth and success of the admissions department. By fostering a collaborative environment, he ensures seamless coordination between his team, other internal departments, and external referral partners, creating a clear and supportive path to care for all clients. Passionate about reducing the barriers that prevent people from accessing necessary treatment, Nicholas is deeply committed to supporting individuals and their families through one of the most critical decisions of their lives. When he's not busy guiding his team or refining internal systems, he enjoys spending time outdoors and exploring creative outlets, which help him stay grounded and energized for the important work he does.

name: Norberto Segredo
bio:
Norberto serves as a dedicated Case Manager committed to empowering clients to achieve mastery over their mental health and recovery from substance use. He approaches his work with compassion, structure, and a deep belief in each individual's capacity for meaningful and lasting change.
His clinical perspective is grounded in his own recovery journey, which began in 2012. Having navigated both substance and process addictions alongside mental health challenges, Norberto brings a powerful lived-experience lens to his role. His personal transformation was further shaped through years of mentorship under the late Bob Proctor, where he studied the science of rewiring the mind to support sustainable growth and behavioral change.
Norberto specializes in integrating multiple recovery frameworks—including SMART Recovery, Dharma Recovery, and the 12-Step model—within a holistic wellness approach. He emphasizes a personalized 'toolkit' model, incorporating nutrition, meditation, exercise, and sauna therapy to strengthen resilience and long-term stability. With experience as both a peer specialist and group facilitator, his mission is to guide each client from simply surviving to truly thriving.

name: Olivia Hadjerioua
bio:
Olivia Hadjerioua serves as Executive Director for Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness Center, where she oversees daily operations across both Texas facilities while supporting initiatives centered on quality care, team development, and client success.
Originally from Tennessee, Olivia brings a compassionate, people-centered approach to leadership rooted in her clinical background as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC). With experience working across all levels of care, she is deeply passionate about helping individuals navigate mental health and substance use recovery with dignity, support, and hope.
In her leadership role, Olivia is committed to fostering a culture of accountability, integrity, and excellence while creating an environment where both clients and staff can thrive. Her dedication to operational excellence and individualized care continues to support the growth and mission of both Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness Center.

name: Phillip Carter
bio:
Phillip Carter serves as the Director of Operations at Hillside Mission Recovery, bringing extensive experience in criminal justice, behavioral health, and recovery support. He began his career with the Indiana Department of Corrections, where he spent eight years working in state parole, case management, crisis intervention, and employment placement. During that time, he developed a strong foundation in meeting individuals where they are, navigating high-pressure situations with steadiness, and helping people recognize their potential—even when they struggle to see it themselves.
Phillip joined Hillside Mission Recovery as a Behavioral Health Technician and steadily advanced through leadership roles including Lead Tech and Case Manager before stepping into his current position as Director of Operations. He also spent two years managing sober living homes, an experience that strengthened his commitment to supporting individuals as they rebuild their lives with structure, accountability, and hope.
As Director of Operations, Phillip leads with integrity, grit, and compassion. He is deeply invested in cultivating a strong team culture and empowering staff to grow into their strengths. Seeing both clients and team members develop confidence, resilience, and purpose is what fuels his passion for the work. Phillip remains dedicated to helping create an environment where lasting recovery and meaningful transformation are possible.

name: Shawn Young
bio:
As the Executive Director of Southern California, I have the privilege of leading a team of dedicated professionals across several substance abuse treatment facilities — but at the heart of what I do is people. Whether it's helping a client take their first step toward recovery or supporting a staff member as they grow into leadership, my passion lies in developing others and building environments where people can thrive.
I didn't get here by accident. I worked my way up through this field — from cooking in the kitchen and working as a tech, to becoming a clinician, and now serving in executive leadership. That journey gave me a deep understanding of what this work really takes — grit, heart, and an unwavering commitment to showing up for people when they need it most.
I believe recovery is more than just treatment — it's a life long journey that we have the privilege of helping people build that foundation.
At the end of the day, I'm a husband and a father. My family is my foundation and the reason I lead with heart. The way I show up at home is how I try to show up in this work — grounded, honest, and fully present.
This isn't just a job to me — it's a calling, and I'm all in.

name: Shán Raiford
bio:
Shán Raiford is a National Certified Recovery Coach (NCRC) and experienced Case Manager with over a decade of service in the addiction treatment field. Since beginning his career in 2013, he has built a reputation for compassionate leadership, ethical practice, and results-driven client advocacy.
With a foundation in behavioral health, recovery coaching, and case management, Shán specializes in comprehensive needs assessment, individualized service planning, care coordination, and discharge planning across multiple levels of care.
